definitions.explanation: The act of taking off clothes. Often used in reference to changing rooms at baths, pools, or medical facilities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{脱衣所|だついじょ}→脱衣所：17619_datsuijo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{脱衣|だつい}かご⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put my belongings in a basket in the hot spring changing area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{診察|しんさつ}→診察：03259_shinsatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上半身|じょうはんしん}→上半身：11509_jouhanshin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{脱衣|だつい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}められた→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: I was asked to undress from the waist up before the examination.

notes:
Composed of {脱|だつ} (to remove, to take off) + {衣|い} (clothing). Most commonly encountered in compound words like ⟦{脱衣所|だついじょ}→脱衣所：17619_datsuijo⟧ (changing room) and {脱衣|だつい}かご (undressing basket), especially at public baths, hot springs, and swimming pools.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{脱衣所|だついじょ}→脱衣所：17619_datsuijo⟧: changing room; undressing room
- {脱衣|だつい}かご: basket for clothes (at a bathhouse)
- {脱衣|だつい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to undress
- {脱衣場|だついば}: changing area

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{着替|きが}え→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧: changing clothes — implies putting on different clothes, not just removing them
- ⟦{更衣|こうい}→更衣：23085_koui⟧: changing clothes — a more formal synonym, as in ⟦{更衣室|こういしつ}→更衣室：07042_kouishitsu⟧ (changing room)
